scope: Existing bounded alphabetical 5000-row snapshot only; no archive refresh, downloads, FITS reads, or use of production hit values.

quality_cuts.unique_exposure_proxy: normalized target plus numeric MJD start, retaining latest ADP ID

selected_overlap_exclusion: Both selected ADP IDs and normalized target plus numeric t_min are excluded, removing alternative reprocessings with the same target and start time. Raw-ID identity checks remain PENDING.

proposed_batch100.estimate_method: access_estsize multiplied by 1024 per archive size unit, conservatively allowing binary kB interpretation; metadata estimate, not verified payload size.
proposed_batch100.selection_rule: Target-balanced round-robin allocations in fixed alphabetical original-target order until 100, capped by each target's available metadata count; maximize distinct nights, prefer nights absent from the original 105, then evenly space available night ranks; fill any remaining quota using evenly spaced unused exposure ranks.
proposed_batch100.original_main_group_requirement_retained: All original 20 targets qualified before the pilot. Three represented targets have fewer than five extra exposures; the proposal does not claim every extra-only target group meets 5 epochs/3 nights.

limitations: Raw progenitor matching against the original 105 and upstream references remains pending any future downloads; metadata target/start deduplication is not a proven raw-exposure identity.
Absence from known upstream ADP references does not establish that data were never searched; prior-search coverage remains unknown.
The snapshot's alphabetical order and 5000-row cap remain selection limitations; counts do not estimate all available HARPS data.
Targets use catalog labels, not newly verified physical identities; future header and coordinate checks are required.
Development stars remain a separate reserved category and are not proposed as new main targets.
Future transfer size and scientific quality must be measured; no added exposure has been downloaded or analyzed by this feasibility task.
